title: Storm Release
body:
Storm Release forms from Lightning + Water. Choose a second nature at level 25 after revealing your first at level 10; Dust Release additionally requires a third nature revealed at level 100. Clan Kekkei Genkai holders cannot gain an elemental release.

Techniques:
Level 25: Laser Current (help laser current)
Level 45: Guiding Lightning (help guiding lightning)
Level 70: Storm Dragon Torrent (help storm dragon torrent)
